t: Din hammoshit yado letzinnur birshut harabbim lishtot
s: Din hammoshit yado letzinnur birshut harabbim lishtot ubo b' seipim: lo yaamod adam birshut harabbim vichabber yado o keli lemazchila, shehi keen tzinnor arok munnachat leorek haggag betok shelosha tepachim samuk laggag, uleqabbel hammayim mimmenna, lepi shehamchabber yado o keli eleha hu keshoeb mimmenna, vehoil vehi (munnachat kullah) betok g' tepachim laggag, vahare hi chashuba kaggag atzmo mishshum torat labud, nimtza shehu keshoeb umotzi mehaggag atzmo, shehu reshut hayyachid, lirshut harabbim. Ulepikak, apillu im hammazchila enah geboha asara veenah rechaba d', sheenah reshut hayyachid mitztzad atzmah — asur lechabber yado o keli eleha, hoil vehu keshoeb umotzi mehaggag. Abal muttar liqlot min haavir, apillu yadayv tok g' lemazchila en omerim bahem labud (leinyan zeh sheyyehe nechshab keshoeb mimmenna). Vaapillu im hu gaboah asara urechaba d', shehi reshut hayyachid — muttar liqlot uleqabbel min haavir hammayim hannotepim mimmenna. Vehu haddin lenotepim mehaggag atzmo, ben sheqqoletan lemala measara ben lematta measara, mippene shellemala measara avir meqom petur hu, ulematta measara reshut harabbim hu:

Hayeta mazchila boletet g' tepachim min haggag, veken setam tzinnor shehu arok ubolet g' tepachim min haggag — enam chashubim kaggag atzmo, umuttar lechabber yado o keli alehem leqabbel hammayim. Vehu sheen bahem d' al d', vehem lematta measara. Sheim yesh bahem rochab d', apillu hem lematta measara, al kol panim hem kekarmelit, ukeshemmechabber yado o keli alehem — hare hu keshoeb umotzi mikkarmelit lirshut harabbim. Veim hem lemala measara, ap sheen bahem d' — asur, mishshum gezera shemma yehe bahem d', sheaz hem reshut hayyachid gemura. Veap al pi shehaggedayim boqeim tachtehem, mikkol maqom hoil vehem boletim veyotzeim min haggag shehu reshut hayyachid, hare hem niddonim kechore reshut hayyachid shehem kirshut hayyachid, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h:
